title: 4× unused argument (W0613): `project_id` (L110), `args` (L215, L220, L225)
detail: The callback functions `always_zero_usage` (line 110) and the internal count helpers `_keypair_count`, `_server_group_count`, `_server_group_members_count` (lines 215–225) accept positional `*args` or `project_id` parameters that are never used. These are oslo_limit callback signatures. The unused `*args` in the count helpers silently absorbs extra arguments; if the oslo_limit API ever changes calling convention, the mismatch will be invisible. Fix: prefix unused parameters with `_` to document intent and make the discard explicit.
